title: YAML config loaded with safe_load and validated against a schema
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag reading a config file as a code-execution risk or the strict unknown-key check as brittle. safe_load is used precisely so YAML tags cannot construct arbitrary Python objects; the loaded value must be a mapping; unknown keys are rejected so a typo fails loudly at startup instead of being silently ignored; bool is explicitly excluded where an int is required because bool is an int subclass in Python; and ranges (port, timeout) are range-checked before the config reaches the application.
